name: engine_cache_fleet
description: Agent-mode cache fill through POST /stateless: 1000 enrolled agents, each streaming the short syslog sample at 1 event/s, one event per batch (1000 events/s in total), with the H line a real agent sends (the agent profile: name, version, groups, host and cluster), stable per agent. Every agent re-sends well within the engine's metadata-cache TTL, so the cache holds one entry per agent while the event queue stays far from pressure. Scale the fleet and divide events_per_second to keep the total constant (e.g. 100 agents x 10, 5000 x 0.2).
